National rates step of the Load Data wizard

Source: R/wizard-national_rates.R
national_rates_ui.Rd

The user enters the national figures the denominators are calculated from: the survey coverage estimates (in percent) and national rates (as proportions) listed in the app's wizard configuration (cd_wizard_config()), the year of the most recent survey, and the year the surveys start from. The fields show what the dataset already holds, so values taken from an uploaded national survey appear filled in; a banner says so when the user has uploaded a national survey. Each change is saved to the dataset shortly after it is made. The step counts as complete when every listed field has a value and the survey year is set (see step_national_rates_complete()).

Usage

national_rates_ui(id, i18n)

national_rates_server(id, cache, i18n)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

Value

national_rates_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: a card with the groups of fields. national_rates_server() is called for its side effects and returns nothing useful.

Details

What is saved:

  • survey coverage estimates, rounded to one decimal place, with cache()$set_survey_estimates();

  • national rates, rounded to three decimal places, with cache()$set_national_estimates();

  • the most recent survey year (2015 to 2030) with cache()$set_survey_year(), or cache()$clear_survey_year() when the user empties the field;

  • the survey start year with cache()$set_start_survey_year(). This field is a list of cache()$survey_years and only shows when the dataset has survey years. When the saved start year is not one of them, the earliest is saved in its place.

Emptying an estimate or a rate field saves a missing value (NA) for it, which makes the step incomplete again.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the app describes the step's fields once, before the wizard is used
options(cd2030.wizard = list(national_rates_groups = list(
  cd_wizard_field_group("title_upload_group_maternal", "sub_upload_group_maternal",
    cd_wizard_survey_field("anc4_prop", "anc4", "title_upload_anc4_survey"),
    cd_wizard_national_rate_fields()
  )
)))

# in the server of the Load Data screen, where `cache` is a reactive holding the dataset:
# the step's page, for wizard_steps_server(), and its server
panel <- list(key = "national_rates", ui = national_rates_ui(ns("national_rates"), i18n))
national_rates_server("national_rates", cache, i18n)
} # }
